2607.08285.title: Psychological Competence as a Missing Dimension in AI Evaluation
2607.08285.paper_summary: Current AI evaluation frameworks focus primarily on technical performance, including accuracy, robustness, reasoning ability, and policy compliance. These measures remain essential, but they are not sufficient for systems that interact directly with users through natural language. Human-facing AI systems are increasingly used as advisors, coaches, tutors, and companions. In these roles, their responses can shape how users reason, interpret emotions, form beliefs, calibrate trust, and make decisions. The relevant unit of evaluation is therefore not only the model, but the human-AI interaction. This paper introduces psychological competence as a missing dimension in AI evaluation. We define psychological competence as the capacity of a human-facing AI system to support user cognition, emotional interpretation, and behavioral decision-making in ways that are appropriate to the user, context, and purpose of the interaction. This includes interaction properties such as framing, tone, perceived authority, responsiveness, uncertainty handling, and conversational guidance. Existing evaluation approaches capture parts of this problem but rarely assess these psychological effects directly. Drawing on behavioral science and human-AI interaction research, we outline a conceptual framework for psychological competence and its core domains. Rather than proposing a specific benchmark, we define the construct, clarify its boundaries, and describe how it may be assessed through scenario-based probes, structured human evaluation, and model-assisted evaluation methods. We argue that psychological competence should become a core consideration for model providers, deploying organizations, researchers, and regulators concerned with the real-world effects of human-facing AI systems.
2607.08285.paper_summary_zh: 目前的人工智慧評估框架主要集中在技術性能上，包括準確性、穩健性、推理能力和政策遵從性。這些指標仍然至關重要，但對於通過自然語言直接與用戶互動的系統來說，它們並不足夠。面向人類的人工智慧系統越來越多地被用作顧問、教練、導師和伴侶。在這些角色中，它們的回應可以影響用戶的推理方式、情感解讀、信念形成、信任校準和決策過程。因此，相關的評估單位不僅是模型，而是人類與人工智慧的互動。本文引入心理能力作為人工智慧評估中缺失的一個維度。我們將心理能力定義為面向人類的人工智慧系統在適合用戶、上下文和互動目的的方式下支持用戶認知、情感解讀和行為決策的能力。這包括互動特性，如框架、語調、感知權威、反應能力、不確定性處理和對話指導。現有的評估方法捕捉了這個問題的部分內容，但很少直接評估這些心理效應。基於行為科學和人類與人工智慧互動研究，我們概述了一個關於心理能力及其核心領域的概念框架。我們並不提出具體的基準，而是定義這一構念，澄清其邊界，並描述如何通過情境探測、結構化人類評估和模型輔助評估方法來進行評估。我們主張，心理能力應該成為模型提供者、部署組織、研究人員和關注面向人類的人工智慧系統實際影響的監管機構的重要考量。
